lines: Can Köseoğlu, Investor Selling Shareholder, is receiving money from selling 299,402 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹4.52 crore are scheduled for On or about Friday, October 23, 2026, per the offer timetable, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Gain of ₹0.62 crore before offer expenses and taxes; retained pre-offer holding is unknown from the documents.
Caveat: the pre-offer holding and allotment date are not confirmed, so lock-in timing for retained shares is unclear.
